scripts.android: APP_ENV=dev sh -c 'npm run CleanThenBuild && npx expo prebuild --platform android && echo Using APP_ENV=$APP_ENV && expo run:android --device'
scripts.build:dev: APP_ENV=dev npx expo prebuild --platform android && npm run CleanThenBuild && eas build -p android --profile development --local --clear-cache
scripts.build:preview: APP_ENV=qa npx expo prebuild --platform android && npm run CleanThenBuild && eas build -p android --profile preview --local --clear-cache
scripts.build:production: APP_ENV=prod npx expo prebuild --platform android && npm run CleanThenBuild &&  eas build -p android --profile production --local --clear-cache
scripts.build:playstore_production: npm run CleanThenBuild && APP_ENV=prod npx expo prebuild --platform android && eas build -p android --profile playstore_production --local --clear-cache
scripts.installFresh:hard: echo Using APP_ENV=$APP_ENV && npx tsx ./AppVersions/UpdateVersion.ts && rm -rf node_modules && ./android/gradlew --stop && rm -rf android/.cxx  && rm -rf android/app/.cxx && rm -rf android/app/build && rm -rf android/build && rm -rf android/.gradle &&  rm -rf ~/.gradle/caches  && rm -rf ~/.gradle/kotlin-dsl && npm i && npx expo prebuild --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd ..
scripts.CleanThenBuild: ./android/gradlew --stop && rm -rf android/.cxx  && rm -rf android/app/.cxx && cd android && ./gradlew clean && cd .. && npx tsx ./AppVersions/UpdateVersionCode.ts
